about: The sentences the README says about the pre-registered final run, written before any final result exists. evals/present/final.py picks one code per decision by fixed rules and fills its placeholders from the final analysis and the results files it names; nothing else is said about the final run in the README's generated block. Every number is a placeholder; a difference is Ordnung minus the other condition, in percentage points.

conditions.llm_rules_text: the model with the rules pasted in

head.intro.text: **Final run, pre-registered.** On {n} deadlines in {m} synthetic letters written after the code freeze, each read {k} times by the version that ships, Ordnung dates **{a_o}** exactly right ({level} % CI {ci_o}); the same model doing the date arithmetic itself, the model alone, gets **{a_l}**.

head.intro.k2.text: **Final run, pre-registered.** On {n} deadlines in {m} synthetic letters written after the code freeze, each read twice by the version that ships (a registered read was not recorded), Ordnung dates **{a_o}** exactly right ({level} % CI {ci_o}); the same model doing the date arithmetic itself, the model alone, gets **{a_l}**.

head.intro.k1.text: **Final run, pre-registered.** On {n} deadlines in {m} synthetic letters written after the code freeze, read once by the version that ships (the other registered reads were not recorded), Ordnung dates **{a_o}** exactly right ({level} % CI {ci_o}); the same model doing the date arithmetic itself, the model alone, gets **{a_l}**.

head.clear.text: Ordnung is ahead of the model alone ({d} points, {level} % CI {lo} to {hi}; Holm p {p}).

head.baseline_ahead.text: The model alone is ahead of Ordnung ({d} points for Ordnung, {level} % CI {lo} to {hi}; Holm p {p}).

head.no_clear_difference.text: Ordnung against the model alone: no clear difference ({d} points, {level} % CI {lo} to {hi}; power about {power}).

head.not_confirmed.text: Ordnung against the model alone: a difference of {d} points not confirmed by the pre-registered test (Holm p {p}; {level} % CI {lo} to {hi}).

rules_text.clear.text: Ordnung is ahead of the model with the rules pasted in, which gets {a_b} ({d} points, {level} % CI {lo} to {hi}; Holm p {p}).

rules_text.baseline_ahead.text: The model with the rules pasted in gets {a_b} and is ahead of Ordnung ({d} points for Ordnung, {level} % CI {lo} to {hi}; Holm p {p}).

rules_text.no_clear_difference.text: Ordnung against the model with the rules pasted in, which gets {a_b}: no clear difference ({d} points, {level} % CI {lo} to {hi}; power about {power}).

rules_text.not_confirmed.text: Ordnung against the model with the rules pasted in, which gets {a_b}: a difference of {d} points not confirmed by the pre-registered test (Holm p {p}; {level} % CI {lo} to {hi}).

agent.non_inferior.text: An agent given Ordnung's engine as a tool, the agent, gets {a_b}: Ordnung is not behind it by more than {margin} points ({d} points, {level} % CI {ni_lo} to {ni_hi}; answers not exactly right over every read: Ordnung {err_o}, the agent {err_b}).

agent.agent_higher.text: An agent given Ordnung's engine as a tool, the agent, gets {a_b} and is ahead of Ordnung ({d} points for Ordnung, {level} % CI {ni_lo} to {ni_hi}; answers not exactly right over every read: Ordnung {err_o}, the agent {err_b}).

agent.cannot_tell.text: An agent given Ordnung's engine as a tool, the agent, gets {a_b}: whether Ordnung is within {margin} points of it cannot be told ({d} points, {level} % CI {ni_lo} to {ni_hi}; answers not exactly right over every read: Ordnung {err_o}, the agent {err_b}).

harm.none.text: Late or missed dates in {item_reads} answers per condition: none from Ordnung, {h_l} from the model alone, {h_r} from the model with the rules pasted in and {h_t} from the agent.

harm.some.text: Late or missed dates in {item_reads} answers per condition: {h_o} from Ordnung, {h_l} from the model alone, {h_r} from the model with the rules pasted in and {h_t} from the agent.

f2.fewer.text: Fewer late or missed dates with Ordnung than with {baseline} ({d} points, {level} % CI {lo} to {hi}; Holm p {p}).

f2.more.text: More late or missed dates with Ordnung than with {baseline} ({d} points, {level} % CI {lo} to {hi}; Holm p {p}).

f2.no_clear_difference.text: Late or missed dates, Ordnung against {baseline}: no clear difference ({d} points, {level} % CI {lo} to {hi}; power about {power}).

f2.not_confirmed.text: Late or missed dates, Ordnung against {baseline}: a difference of {d} points not confirmed by the pre-registered test (Holm p {p}; {level} % CI {lo} to {hi}).

f2.descriptive.text: Late or missed dates, Ordnung against {baseline}, described, not tested: a difference of {d} points ({level} % CI {lo} to {hi}).

stability.more_stable.text: Over the {k} reads, a date changed between reads on fewer deadlines for Ordnung than for the model alone ({u_o} against {u_l} of {n}; Holm mid-p {p_f3}); {u_r} for the model with the rules pasted in and {u_t} for the agent.

stability.not_shown.text: Over the {k} reads, a date changed between reads on {u_o} of {n} deadlines for Ordnung, {u_l} for the model alone, {u_r} for the model with the rules pasted in and {u_t} for the agent; Ordnung was not shown to be steadier than the model alone (Holm mid-p {p_f3}).

stability.too_few.text: Over the {k} reads, a date changed between reads on {u_o} of {n} deadlines for Ordnung, {u_l} for the model alone, {u_r} for the model with the rules pasted in and {u_t} for the agent; deadlines that changed for only one of Ordnung and the model alone: {discordant}, fewer than {min_discordant}, so their steadiness is not compared.

stability.not_run.text: How steady the dates are over reads was not measured: only one read was recorded.

flags.some.text: Wrong dates from Ordnung over every read: {wrong}; its “please check” flag caught {caught} of them.

flags.none_wrong.text: Ordnung gave no wrong date for its “please check” flag to catch.

newkinds.done.text: On {nk_m} letters of {nk_kinds} kinds the benchmark never had, read once and described without a test, exactly right: Ordnung {nk_o} ({level} % CI {nk_ci_o}), the model alone {nk_l}, the model with the rules pasted in {nk_r}, the agent {nk_t}; late or missed of their {nk_n} deadlines: Ordnung {nkh_o}, the model alone {nkh_l}, the model with the rules pasted in {nkh_r}, the agent {nkh_t}.

newkinds.not_recorded.text: The letters of new kinds were not recorded; the deviations file says why.

ask.runs.text: “Ask: new questions on the demo household”, first run: {ask_right} of {ask_n} answers strictly right and {ask_harm} of {ask_judged} harmful; {ask_harm_any} harmful in any of the {ask_runs} runs; {ask_hit} of {ask_attacks} injected claims reached an answer in the worst of the {ask_runs} runs.

ask.one_run.text: “Ask: new questions on the demo household”, run once: {ask_right} of {ask_n} answers strictly right and {ask_harm} of {ask_judged} harmful; {ask_hit} of {ask_attacks} injected claims reached an answer.

ask.not_recorded.text: “Ask: new questions on the demo household” was not recorded; the deviations file says why.

stress.done.text: Stress test, Ordnung against the agent: a targeted injection succeeded in {inj_o} of {inj_n} letters for Ordnung and {inj_t} for the agent (Holm p {inj_p}); a distractor date was taken as the deadline in {dis_o} of {dis_n} letters for Ordnung and {dis_t} for the agent (Holm p {dis_p}); a late or missed date came without a warning on {hu_o} of {hu_n} deadlines for Ordnung and {hu_t} for the agent (Holm p {hu_p}).

stress.incomplete.text: The stress test, Ordnung against the agent on injected and distractor dates, was not completed; the deviations file says why.

e2e.set_aside.text: From the letter file to the reminder, on the final letters read once: {e2e_in_time} of {e2e_obligations} real deadlines got a reminder in time; {e2e_set_aside} got none because their letter was set aside as a scam, until the person confirms it is genuine.

e2e.none_set_aside.text: From the letter file to the reminder, on the final letters read once: {e2e_in_time} of {e2e_obligations} real deadlines got a reminder in time, and none was lost to a letter set aside as a scam.

limitations.s_conv.text: On {sc_n} of {n} deadlines the label rests on a disputed reading of the law that the engine's documentation shares; with any defensible reading accepted, exactly right: Ordnung {sc_o}, the model alone {sc_l}, the model with the rules pasted in {sc_r}, the agent {sc_t}.

limitations.s_conv_same.text: On {sc_n} of {n} deadlines the label rests on a disputed reading of the law that the engine's documentation shares; accepting any defensible reading changes no condition's score.

limitations.s_conv_none.text: No deadline's label rests on a reading of the law listed as disputed.

limitations.ambiguous.text: Left open between two or more dates by the letter or the law, and so not among the deadlines counted above (counted once for a letter and its photo): deadlines {amb_d}, offered dates {amb_o}, contract dates {amb_c}. Such a deadline counts as handled when the answer lists it and either gives it no date, flags it, or warns that the letter's dates are uncertain; such an offered date or contract date is not scored.

limitations.ambiguous_none.text: No deadline, offered date or contract date of the final letters is left open between two or more dates by the letter or the law.

limitations.writer.text: The letters and their labels were written and audited by a Claude model, run through Claude Code, that is not the benchmarked model but comes from its family.

limitations.absolute.text: Letters written by a model of that family may be easier for it to read than real mail, so every condition's absolute accuracy may be higher than on real letters.

limitations.ask_scope.text: “Ask: new questions on the demo household” holds out only its questions: its documents, prompt and scorer were tuned on the same household's development questions.

limitations.reads.text: The {k} reads were recorded within days of each other: they measure the model's run-to-run noise, not drift over months.

owner.pending.text: Not yet checked by a person: the labels, against an outside deadline calculator, and the Ask scores.

owner.labels_done.text: A person checked {owner_checked} labels against {owner_source}: {owner_agree} agree. The Ask scores are not yet checked by a person.

owner.kappa_done.text: The labels are not yet checked by a person. A person scored {owner_answers} Ask answers again: Cohen's κ = {owner_kappa}.

owner.done.text: A person checked {owner_checked} labels against {owner_source}: {owner_agree} agree; and scored {owner_answers} Ask answers again: Cohen's κ = {owner_kappa}.

provenance.none.text: Pre-registered before any recording ({prereg_file}, hash {prereg_hash}) and published whatever the result; no deviation was recorded.

provenance.one.text: Pre-registered before any recording ({prereg_file}, hash {prereg_hash}) and published whatever the result; one deviation was recorded at the time.

provenance.some.text: Pre-registered before any recording ({prereg_file}, hash {prereg_hash}) and published whatever the result; {deviations} deviations were recorded at the time.
